query: SELECT id,source,external_id,title,company_name,location_text,city,state,countryiso,posted_at,apply_url,is_active,is_duplicate,description,html_description_text,alive,alive_checked_at,alive_valid_until,requirements_summary,responsibilities_summary,technical_tools_summary FROM met_career_match_jobposting WHERE company_name ~* %s ORDER BY id
date_window: All available posting dates; no row limit
date_note: created_at is database creation/collection time, not actual posting time; no fabricated date imputation.
